method: Inspected each encoded 16-frame chronological overview and native-resolution last frame; earlier generated full scene/face 2fps and hands 8fps supplied denser motion review. No continuous-playback claim.

findings.picture: No visible render-added blank frames, overlays, framing change or end corruption. Known long downward gaze and brief mouth parting remain.
Mouse-to-keyboard transfer and return survive encode; no visible render-added artifact. Frequent gaze checks and missing second typing burst remain.
Selected reading/typing/pause/reposition interval survives encode; later sustained hover excluded. Brief mid-interval elevated fingers during reposition and stiffness remain.

audio: All final MP4s have no audio stream.
comparison_links: All local video, source image and original take links exist.
limitations: Qualitative studies, not a controlled demonstration of improved realism.
